name: science-agent
description: Citation, prose, figure, and rigor auditing for AI-assisted research drafts

plugins.name: science-agent
plugins.description: Validates citations against CrossRef/BibTeX, audits figures, prose, notebooks, and rigor. Slash commands /audit /verify /search /figure-audit /notebook-audit /hypothesis-card /arxiv /aggregate plus rigor-audit and figure-audit sub-agents.
